brief: Doc 32 Q-CF-44: fixture-seeded opposing forces, authored as content. A raider is a party of armed hulls one NPC leader stands behind, seeded on a named frontier site by staff (@field/raiders <id>). It flies the kernel's doctrine (each hull's ROM seal, Standard Doctrine) and its leader holds a standing Hostile mark on every other party in any field it is admitted to. No generator, no respawn, no patrol: a seeded raider stays until it is destroyed, and seeding it again is refused while any of its hulls stands.
